name: Aakash T C S
headline: Generative AI Engineer
tagline: I build AI agents and automations that take the boring parts of people's jobs off their hands. Mostly in Python, usually with LangGraph, occasionally at 2 a.m.
availability: Currently building AI agents at Movate
about: I'm an AI Engineer at Movate. Day to day, I build multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, retrieval systems that show their sources, and the plumbing that connects LLMs to real business tools, for clients like Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise and Nokia.

I care about the unglamorous parts too: guardrails, logging, and keeping one user's conversation well away from another's. An agent that's clever but unreliable is just a very confident intern. After hours I'm building Cortana, my own assistant, mostly to see how far one person can push it.

experience.summary: Building generative AI for enterprise clients, including Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise and Nokia.
points: Designed and refined prompts and RAG workflows for enterprise LLM applications, using contextual enrichment to ground responses.
Built modular LangChain/LangGraph workflows with conditional routing, tool invocation and conversation state for multi-step tasks.
Integrated Azure OpenAI, Gemini/Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock (Claude) and Groq with Python services and REST APIs.

Contributed to prototypes in agentic AI, RAG-to-DAX automation, customer-support analysis, fraud analysis and semi-agentic chatbots.

projects.title: Agent-Native Conversational Chatbot
projects.imageAlt: Architecture: a customer message goes to a LangGraph orchestrator, which uses a Neo4j GraphRAG intent map to route it to support, knowledge or ticketing agents; the ticketing agent calls a Salesforce MCP tool to raise a ticket.
projects.summary: A support chatbot where a small team of specialised agents, not one overworked model, handles each request. It works out what the customer needs, hands it to the right agent, and can raise a Salesforce ticket on its own.
highlights: A LangGraph orchestrator passes each request to the agent best suited to it.
A Neo4j knowledge graph, queried with Cypher-based GraphRAG, decides which agent that is.
Salesforce APIs are exposed as MCP tools, so a ReAct agent can raise a ticket when someone asks for one.
Guardrails, logging, saved conversation history, and separate sessions so nobody sees anyone else's chat.
projects.impact: 200+ people use it regularly in production

projects.title: AI Document Extraction & Analytics View
projects.imageAlt: Architecture: business documents pass through a private LLM gateway into MySQL; an engineer's question goes through a LangGraph router to a SQL agent that queries MySQL and returns an answer and an analytics view.
projects.summary: Useful answers were buried in business documents. This pulls them out into a database, then lets engineers ask questions in plain English and get answers and charts back.
highlights: LLM workflows read business documents and store the structured results in MySQL.
LangGraph sends chat and analytics questions to a SQL agent that knows the schema.
Document understanding runs through an enterprise private LLM gateway.
The structured output feeds reporting, analytics and search further down the line.
projects.impact: Network engineers use it for technical questions and analytics

projects.title: Natural Language to Pandas Analytics
projects.imageAlt: A plain-English question becomes generated pandas code, which passes syntax, logic and generated test-case checks with bounded retries before returning a results table.
projects.summary: Ask a dataset a question in plain English and get the answer back, without anyone hand-writing pandas. The generated code has to pass its checks before anyone trusts it.
highlights: Turns a question plus the DataFrame's schema into pandas filtering code.
Checks syntax and logic, runs generated test cases, and retries a limited number of times before giving up gracefully.
projects.impact: Bad code gets caught before it runs, not after

projects.title: Grounded Q&A with Vertex AI Vector Search
projects.imageAlt: A question is embedded with BGE, matched against a Vertex AI Vector Search index, and the top retrieved passages ground a Gemini answer with citations.
projects.summary: Answers questions from a document collection, and only from it. If the answer isn't in the sources, it shouldn't be in the reply.
highlights: Vertex AI Vector Search index and endpoint built on BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings.
Retrieved passages feed Gemini, with care taken over grounding, retrieval quality and safety settings.
projects.impact: Every answer is backed by a retrieved source

projects.title: Cortana: My Personal AI Assistant
projects.imageAlt: A glowing holographic orb representing Cortana, surrounded by glass cards: a recalled memory from a past conversation, a research dossier in progress, a voice-lock check, and a listening waveform.
projects.summary: My own Halo-inspired assistant, and my favourite after-hours project. She talks in real time, remembers what we discussed last week, and goes off to research things while I get on with my day. She also has opinions about my workout form.
highlights: Remembers our conversations. Each session is summarised and stored, so I can ask what we decided about something last week and she'll find it.
Keeps a separate memory of facts I ask her to hold on to, and brings them up when they're relevant.
Runs research missions in the background: she searches the web, then writes up a full dossier, in the style of a Halo intelligence briefing.
Answers from my own PDFs, using semantic chunking, FastEmbed vectors and a ClickHouse vector store.
projects.impact: 10 research dossiers written so far, and counting
